trap.label: suggest + objeto
trap.why: O português aceita "sugeriu-me descansar". Em inglês, suggest não leva objeto + to: use that-clause ou -ing.

opts: He admitted to that he was late.
He admitted that he was late.
He admitted me he was late.

mcq.q: Qual verbo usa objeto direto de pessoa?

fix.wrong: He told that the shop was closed.
fix.right: He said that the shop was closed.

fix.wrong: She suggested me to go home.
fix.right: She suggested that I go home.
They explained the problem to me.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com admitted: “‘I broke it,’ Leo said.”
Reescreva com promised: “‘I will help,’ she said.”
Reescreva com warned: “‘Don't touch it,’ he said to us.”
rewrite.answer: He warned us not to touch it.
